Design saved to `/tmp/updates-browse-astra.md`.

Recommendation: optional wheel button height, exact matching semicircle paths, feature-owned sorting/pagination, and existing Button controls. Preserve timestamp precision through nine fractional digits. SSR tests must count rendered rows because serialized loader data still includes every entity.
